summary: This 6-K reports K Wave Media Ltd. entering a Rescission and Termination Agreement on May 29, 2026, rescinding its March 31, 2023 acquisition of 95% of Solaire Partners LLC. The original purchase was paid with 9,827,057 ordinary shares, which the Rescission Sellers (including Chairman Pyeungho Choi) must return within 60 days; in exchange, the company will transfer back the Solaire equity. Chairman Choi also agreed to resign within 60 days of the transfers. A mutual release covers all claims related to the original purchase agreement. The mechanics involve an unwind of a stock-based acquisition, with no cash consideration. The rescission suggests a failed integration or undisclosed issues, and the risk-arb angle is moot since the deal is being unwound, but watch for any disputes or regulatory implications from the share return and board resignation.
